MSXMusic_Detect

View source

Search for MSX-Music (YM2413) chip

Return

MSXMUSIC_NOTFOUND if no MSX-Music chip found MSXMUSIC_INTERNAL if an internal MSX-Music chip is found MSXMUSIC_EXTERNAL if an external MSX-Music chip (FM-PAC)

Get the Slot ID of the first MSX-Music chip found MSXMusic_Detect or MSXMusic_Initialize must be called first

Return

Slot ID if found or SLOT_NOTFOUND otherwise

MSXMusic_GetChannelCount
u8 MSXMusic_GetChannelCount()
View source

Get the number of MSX-Music channels: 9 melodic channels, or 6 melodic channels and 5 rhythm instruments in rhythm mode

Return

Number of channels (9 or 11)

MSXMusic_GetChannelVolume
u8 MSXMusic_GetChannelVolume(
u8 
chan
)
View source

Get the current volume of a given channel (instrument volume, based on the values written with MSXMusic_SetRegister)

Parameters
chan
u8

Channel index (0 to 8; in rhythm mode, 0 to 5 for melodic channels and 6 to 10 for bass drum, snare drum, tom-tom, top cymbal and high hat)

Return

Volume from 0 (mute) to 15 (max). 0 if the channel (or rhythm instrument) is not keyed on

MSXMusic_IsChannelTriggered
bool MSXMusic_IsChannelTriggered(
u8 
chan
)
View source

Check if a given channel (or rhythm instrument) has been keyed on since the last check (also detects a key off followed by a key on within the same frame) Note: The trigger flag is cleared by this function.

Parameters
chan
u8

Channel index (same as MSXMusic_GetChannelVolume)

Return

TRUE if a new note has been started on this channel since the last call
